title: too qarkayto too wakaak safarte
intro: qeedaalissok iroh tan gaddat barkat leh tan gaddali amoytiinul kaxxa reedanti miraacisak suge. qammalsime wayte gexkalit ugte wak, ta miraacah foocal gibbatu seefitte hinnay wale kee amanti. maca fakkimteh baad caylih fayyak sorkocobaxak adda xeerih yan milaagu fan miraacisele.
clues: Anu amoytiinul xiiniseh gaddaliinoo kee leeda mablak dagah
Anu caylale amoytak suge xayyos esserak libdole ayyufta hirge
Yi amoytit yoo fayseh qeebi abam akkek salaam ta allah yan amoyta lih
Anu innih tama allah yan amoytat ongoorowuh kaxxa acwoowit bicse
Yi amoytiini qarkayto anu aduureyyok naharal, inti urruk allal tan baaxo fan baahen
anu daala cule wak gidaar mereyyah innah sahlinih, anu ellecaboh yallih rammitiyya warse

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
